dedupe_keys.name: selection of mine acess for underground mining

description: Higor José Silva Campos and colleagues publish a web tool for early selection of underground mine access and ore transport systems. Zenodo archives version 2.0.0 under MIT and links a Vue.js repository. Users compare shaft, ramp-and-truck and inclined conveyor alternatives under three published decision methods. The README names depth, production rate, rock-mass quality and geotechnical constraints as inputs, with interactive flowcharts and exportable comparisons. The outputs can define access alternatives before mine logistics or capacity simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tool. Coverage is conceptual underground-mine planning, not a detailed engineering design for a specific deposit. A limitation is that the site’s heuristics provide preliminary guidance and do not replace geological, geotechnical or cost feasibility studies. The provider-hosted version and local build were not operated, and recommendation results were not independently checked.
